item.title: Welcome, City Lights: Residents of northeast Bakersfield excited about retail project, even though construction has barely started
item.description: The City Lights shopping center hasn’t even broken ground over the old abandoned footprint of East Hills Mall, but northeast Bakersfield appears to be unanimous in its excited anticipation. At least that’s what we found in our mini-survey.

item.title: Uber launches women-only option in the US
item.description: Uber launched a feature Monday to allow both women riders and drivers across the U.S. to be matched with other women for trips, expanding a pilot program aimed at addressing concerns about the safety of its riding-hailing platform.

item.title: Rihanna's L.A. home struck by gunfire while pop star reportedly inside
item.description: Approximately 10 shots were fired at the pop star’s residence.

item.title: Man dead after being ejected from motorcycle near Camp Nine: CHP
item.description: BAKERSFIELD, Calif. (KGET) -- A man is dead after being ejected from a motorcycle in Kernville, according to the California Highway Patrol. CHP said the crash happened Saturday just after 8:30 p.m. on Sierra Way, south of Camp Nine. item.title: Grupo Frontera set to come to the Central Valley
item.description: Grupo Frontera announced that it will be coming to Fresno on August 8th as part of its "Triste Pero Bien C*brón Tour", with tickets going on sale on March 13th.

item.title: Helicopter crashes while laying powerlines near Mojave, 1 person dead: NTSB officials
item.description: One person was killed in a helicopter crash in a remote area outside Mojave on Monday afternoon, fire officials said.

item.title: 1 arrested during courthouse altercation following Anabell Correa hearing
item.description: A supportive remark from a family member to a woman in custody sparked a courthouse altercation Monday, resulting in the arrest of one person and another getting escorted from the building.

item.title: Friends mourn man killed in shooting near Oildale saloon
item.description: Friends identified the victim as Jason Hall. He was beloved by many in the community.
